highlights: Naturally dried on traditional bamboo machans
Zero chemical preservatives or artificial bleach
Direct harvest from Dahanu coastline
Hygienically cleaned and vacuum packed
culinaryUse: Best for crispy rava fry, coastal thecha, or spicy curry.

name: Baby Jawla & Red Sukat Prawns
shortDescription: Sweet micro prawns dried on coastal mats. Bursting with umami flavour, perfect for koli masalas.
longDescription: Tiny coastal prawns sun-dried right after landing. Cleaned through triple-sifting to eliminate sand particles. Rich in natural protein and intense seafood sweetness that flavours gravies instantly.
highlights: Triple sifted for zero sand guarantee
Naturally sweet aroma without foul odour
Rich in natural protein, calcium and minerals
Packed in resealable moisture-lock zip pouches
culinaryUse: Saute with caramelized onions, green chillies, garlic and fresh coconut for the legendary Sukat Chutney.

name: White Bombay Duck (Suvva Bombil)
shortDescription: Naturally sun-dried on coastal high machans. Snow-white, zero chemical smell, ultra-crispy texture.
longDescription: Harvested directly from Dahanu traditional bag-net fishing boats and immediately hung on bamboo machans (elevated drying racks) for 3 days of ocean-breeze drying. Retains maximum sea sweetness with zero chemical bleach or preservatives.
highlights: 100% Sun-dried on high bamboo machans (sand-free)
Direct catch from Dahanu Koli fishermen
Zero formalin, preservatives or artificial color
Cleaned, head-trimmed & vacuum sealed
culinaryUse: Ideal for shallow crispy rava fry with garlic-chilli thecha, or authentic coastal dry bombil curry with steamed bhakri.

name: Kingfish Surmai Dry Salted Steaks
shortDescription: Thick, meaty bone-in steaks sea-salt cured and wind dried. Pure coastal royalty on your plate.
longDescription: Selected from large catch Kingfish (Surmai), precisely sliced into meaty steaks, lightly cured in sea salt crystals, and sun-cured under coastal afternoon sun. Dense, rich flaky meat.
highlights: Prime Kingfish surmai meaty steaks
Light sea-salt curing preserves natural juiciness
High protein density & heart-healthy Omega-3s
Vacuum-sealed for 6+ months pantry life
culinaryUse: Soak in warm water for 15 mins to reduce salt, coat in Malvani spices and semolina, and shallow fry in coconut oil.

name: Salt-Cured Indian Mackerel (Bangda)
shortDescription: Full-sized oily mackerel split and sea-salt dried. Rich flavour, authentic village style preparation.
longDescription: Whole fresh Indian mackerels butterfly-split along the spine, gently cured with coarse sea salt and dried on coastal machans. Packed with Omega-3 healthy oils.
highlights: Naturally high Omega-3 fish oil content
Butterfly cut cleaned inside out
No chemical curing or artificial dehydrators
Traditional Dahanu village recipe
culinaryUse: Roast directly over open charcoal or pan-fry with crushed black pepper, turmeric, and lemon juice.
